resources.string: AdGuard DNS over a local VPN
Queries go to 94.140.14.14. Domain ads and trackers on AdGuard’s list are blocked.
Tap Start and accept the Android VPN prompt. No traffic is sent to a remote VPN server.
Android blocked the VPN. You can try again, or set Private DNS to dns.adguard-dns.com in system settings.
Local VPN is only used to apply DNS. This is not a YouTube ad skipper. Ads served from the same hosts as the video still play.
